newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan's Taisil eyes 12-inch wafer plant for 1999.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan's Taisil eyes 12-inch wafer plant for 1999.

text.p: Taiwan's unlisted Taisil Electronic Materials Corp said on Wednesday it may build a large 12-inch wafer plant in the southeastern city of Tainan as early as 1999.
"The plant is still in the planning stage, and we may begin construction in late 1999 to early 2000," Huang Nai-wen a Taisil board officer, told Reuters by telephone.
He said Taisil did not have an immediate timetable on when the plant might be completed.
